purpose: Copy-only 252-connection geometry stress benchmark on endpoint-reviewed digital/control/bus nets; timing, ESD and electrical acceptance remain blocked

unverified: All per-group missing_electrical_checks recorded in scope_review
ESD ingress topology and service attachment
Signal integrity, clock/data skew, setup/hold and RC timing
scope.description: 137 exact nets / 252 native remaining connections across reviewed UI manual inputs, SD card presence, display i8080, SD/SDIO/SPI, interprocessor buses and UART/SWD. Full native 80 x 150 mm board and all existing obstacles retained. No production routing-policy change.

selection: Only full selected connectivity, independent native DRC/parity, unchanged rules and preservation, and added copper inside ROI qualify geometrically; compare time/vias/length on the Pareto frontier. No electrical acceptance.

scope_review.basis: Read-only KiCad native connectivity and every selected native ref/pad matched exactly through H2 controlled-symbol pin maps to endpoint/instance ledgers. Groups include explicit endpoint semantics; routing class alone is never admission. Original 82-connection-case endpoint scope retained and extended by reviewed groups only.

included_groups.reason: Preserve all 15 reviewed manual-key nets from ui-controls-60, including exact switch, pull, ESD and TCA9539 endpoints.
missing_electrical_checks: shared IRQ electrical behavior and digital edge return paths
inter-board encoder ingress and remote endpoint behavior

included_groups.reason: Passive human-input contacts arrive through J18 pins 51/52/53 and 3.32k pulls, terminating at S3 GPIO39/GPIO47 and TCA9539 P12. Only the UI-board half is selected.
missing_electrical_checks: shared IRQ electrical behavior and digital edge return paths
inter-board encoder ingress and remote endpoint behavior

included_groups.reason: Display touch interrupt J1.5 through open-drain SN74LVC1G07 U11 joins TCA9539 INT_N, S3 GPIO3 and hub GPIO5 with 10k pulls. The reset pins, I2C bus and AON/safety alert remain excluded.
missing_electrical_checks: shared IRQ electrical behavior and digital edge return paths
inter-board encoder ingress and remote endpoint behavior

included_groups.reason: TSOP75238 U24.OUT is the active-low demodulated envelope; U26.1A/1Y and 100ohm R119 feed C5 GPIO0 with 10k R118. No optical carrier, emitter, supply, evidence or enable net is selected.
missing_electrical_checks: shared IRQ electrical behavior and digital edge return paths
inter-board encoder ingress and remote endpoint behavior

included_groups.reason: J2/J6/J10 pins 8 and 10 are static header-identity contacts, each behind a 10k pull: S3 0/0, C5 1/0, HUB 0/1 for ID0/ID1. These six explicitly reviewed SERIAL_CONTROL-labelled nets carry no clock, UART, reset, boot or USB signals.
missing_electrical_checks: shared IRQ electrical behavior and digital edge return paths
inter-board encoder ingress and remote endpoint behavior

included_groups.reason: Direct S3 GPIO-to-display J1 data/WR/D-C endpoints; ten members retained as a complete routed geometry group.
Hub RP GPIO7..12 and C5 GPIO7..10/series/pull endpoints. SDIO-only discrete segments selected; USB-shared common nets and USB-switch DAT2/DAT3 branch endpoints excluded.
missing_electrical_checks: series resistor topology and return continuity

included_groups.reason: Five Hub RP GPIO13..17 to M1 J18 digital SPI/alert signals; only UI-board endpoints selected.
missing_electrical_checks: M1 remote endpoints and return contacts

included_groups.reason: Digital carrier-detect receiver U23.CARRIER_OUT to U26 buffer and C5 GPIO1 through R116; supply and all transmit/gate nets excluded.
All three NRF module SPI/IRQ groups through host/return buffers and pull/series resistors. Every CE request/safe/buffered/module transmit-enabling path is excluded.
missing_electrical_checks: SPI timing and skew per radio

included_groups.reason: S3 GPIO21/14/7/8/48 to Hub RP GPIO0..4 five-wire clocked link.
Complete fourteen-net SD SPI/data contact group through U8/U9 buffers, J5 contacts, pulls, series resistors and ESD channels; power/card-enable nets excluded.
J2/J6 UART and J10 SWD signal contacts through series resistors and ESD channels to processor contacts. Reset, boot, VTREF and USB-C CC remain excluded.
S3 GPIO1/2, TCA9539 U13.SCL/SDA and display J1 touch I2C contacts with 3V3 pull resistors.
missing_electrical_checks: I2C bus capacitance and rise time

included_groups.reason: Mechanical J5.DETECT_A card-presence contact through R47 and U7 ESD to Hub RP GPIO44 with pull R46 and filter C12. Although policy labels the RC-filtered group ANALOG_AUDIO_SENSE, its exact contacts carry card-presence logic, not supply or RF.
missing_electrical_checks: contact debounce and RC threshold timing
GPIO input leakage and voltage levels

excluded_groups.reason: All RF, power, ground, oscillator, USB differential/common/CC/VTREF, safety, RF detector/evidence, reset/boot, supply, LED-current and gate nets excluded regardless of fallback routing class.
Clocked-labelled CE request/safe/buffered/module paths control transmitter enable and remain excluded.
Supply, transmit gate, and USB-sharing switch endpoints excluded even when classified CLOCKED_DIGITAL.

scope_review.electrical_acceptance: BLOCKED: no timing, signal-integrity, ESD, return-current or circuit-function qualification is performed by this experiment
